entries.title: Job 26:2
segments: How hast thou helped the powerless; how saved the arm that is without strength!

entries.title: Job 26:3
segments: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom, and abundantly declared the thing as it is!

entries.title: Job 26:4
segments: For whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

entries.title: Job 26:5
segments: ¶The shades tremble beneath the waters and the inhabitants thereof;

entries.title: Job 26:6
segments: Sheol is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

entries.title: Job 26:7
segments: He stretcheth out the north over empty space, he hangeth the earth upon nothing;

entries.title: Job 26:8
segments: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not rent under them.

entries.title: Job 26:9
segments: He covereth the face of his throne, he spreadeth his cloud upon it.

entries.title: Job 26:10
segments: He hath traced a fixed circle over the waters, unto the confines of light and darkness.

entries.title: Job 26:11
segments: The pillars of the heavens tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

entries.title: Job 26:12
segments: He stirreth up the sea by his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through Rahab.

entries.title: Job 26:13
segments: By his Spirit the heavens are adorned; his hand hath formed the fleeing serpent.

entries.title: Job 26:14
segments: Lo, these are the borders of his ways; but what a whisper of a word do we hear of him! And the thunder of his power, who can understand?
